change.title: API version 2022-11-28 (default when no header is sent) ends support March 10, 2028; unversioned requests then fall to next supported version

source.quote: Requests that do not specify an API version default to the next oldest supported version, not the closing down version.

task.notes: None of the GitHub REST calls send X-GitHub-Api-Version, so they use the 2022-11-28 default. When that version loses support on March 10, 2028, the calls will be served as 2026-03-10. From reading the 2026-03-10 breaking list against the fields used (resources.search.limit, html_url, full_name, stargazers_count, starred_at, login, user profile fields), nothing used appears to break. The migration agent should add an explicit X-GitHub-Api-Version header, verify the responses on 2026-03-10 (especially the search item stars field and the user profile fields), and pin it. Impact is low and the deadline is far off.

callSites.why: GET /rate_limit is sent with no X-GitHub-Api-Version header, so it rides on the default 2022-11-28. After 2028-03-10 it falls to 2026-03-10. It reads resources.search.limit, which survives the move (only the top-level 'rate' is removed).
Search repositories is sent unversioned and reads html_url, full_name and stars, so it will move to the next supported version.
Stargazers with the star+json media type is unversioned, so it will move to the next supported version.
GET /users/{login} is unversioned, so it will move to the next supported version.
The unauthenticated GET /users/{login} is unversioned, so it will move to the next supported version.
